title: Operating System Process State Transition
prompt: Generate a state transition diagram of Operating System process states (New, Ready, Running, Waiting, Terminated).
mermaid_code:
stateDiagram-v2

[] New --> Ready
Ready --> Running
Running --> Waiting
Waiting --> Terminated
Terminated --> Closed

Subgraph Process Creation
New --> [Create]

Subgraph Scheduling
Ready --> [Scheduling]
Running --> [Scheduling]

Subgraph Resource Contention
Waiting --> [Resource Contention]

Subgraph Termination
Terminated --> [Termination]

Subgraph Debugging
Terminated --> [Debugging]
explanation: This state diagram illustrates the lifecycle of an operating system process, showing the transition between key states: New, Ready, Running, Waiting, and Terminated. The diagram demonstrates how processes move through these states based on system resources, scheduling, and event-driven behavior. Key concepts include process creation, scheduling, resource contention, and termination.
